ppi.note: December value (100). Quarter showed deceleration from Q3 peak: October held strong at 101.25, November and December settled at 100 each. Holiday season and travel brought productivity back to baseline after Q3's record run.

knowledge-expansion.note: December value (3,482 notes). Strong growth from October baseline of 2,975. Averaging ~169 new notes/month as knowledge capture systems mature. Obsidian vault expanding steadily.

social-capital.note: December value (100.4, raw: 3053.92). Slow but steady growth from October baseline (100). Audience reach expanding incrementally across platforms.

phi.note: December value (75.0). Peaked at 77.9 in November before slight dip. Overall improvement from October's 71.4, with better sleep and increased workout frequency driving gains.

revenue.note: December value (58.6). Major recovery from Q3's restructuring period. Steady climb from October (49.8) through November (38.4 dip) to strong December close. Full-time employment stabilizing finances.

completion-rate.note: December value (16 points). Massive rebound from Q3's low of 5. October (12), November dipped (9), December surged to 16 — best month of 2025. Renewed engagement with longform media.

summary: Recovery and stabilization quarter. Productivity eased from Q3 peak to baseline (100, -4.8%), while wealth surged +155.9% to 58.6 as employment income took hold. Longform Media Velocity exploded +220% to 16 points (best month of 2025). Knowledge base grew 16.2% to 3,482 notes. Health improved 5% to 75.0. Social capital held steady. A quarter of consolidation after Q3's intensity, with strong financial and cultural engagement gains.
highlights: PWI surged 155.9% to 58.6 — strongest financial quarter, full employment income flowing
Longform Media Velocity hit 16 points in December — highest single month of 2025
Knowledge base crossed 3,400 notes, growing ~169 notes/month
PHI improved 5% as health habits strengthened from October baseline
PPI settled at baseline (100) after Q3 peak — natural post-sprint deceleration
All six indicators now actively tracking for first full-data quarter
